title: OCHS Score Object
description: Open Code Health Score (OCHS) v0.1 — a deterministic 1–10 file-health score produced by the OCHS scoring formula: score = max(1.0, 10 − Σ(weight_i × sqrt(count_i))). See https://github.com/screamm/Healthy-AI-Code-MCP/blob/master/docs/ochs/OCHS-v0.1.md

ochsVersion.description: OCHS specification version. MUST be present so downstream consumers can determine formula compatibility.

score.description: The OCHS score for the file. Range: [1.0, 10.0]. Computed as max(1.0, 10 − Σ(weight_i × sqrt(count_i))).

filePath.description: Path to the file that was analysed. Optional but recommended.

language.description: Detected or provided language for the file (e.g., 'typescript', 'python', 'java').

loopComplete.description: True when score meets the AI_READY_THRESHOLD (9.5, or 9.7 if AiAttributedSATD is present). Signals that the file is safe for autonomous AI-assisted modification.

category.description: Score category derived from OCHS thresholds.

smells.description: List of code smell / biomarker findings detected in the file.

metrics.description: Optional supplementary file-level metrics (e.g., lineCount, functionCount, cyclomaticComplexity).

subscores.description: Optional sub-scores by domain (security, complexity, maintainability, duplication). Not part of the mandatory OCHS schema.

severity.description: Severity level of this finding. Informational only — does not affect the score.

line.description: Source line number where the finding starts (1-based).

endLine.description: Source line number where the finding ends (1-based, inclusive).

functionName.description: Name of the function or method where the finding occurs, if applicable.

details.description: Finding-specific detail payload. Schema is biomarker-specific.

SmellType.description: One of the 55 OCHS v0.1 biomarker identifiers.
